selected_script.angle: Low-level garage detailing back pain solved by low-profile ergonomic rolling stool
selected_script.hook: Crouching down on the hard garage floor to detail your wheels is a total pain for your back.

usage_steps_used: Sit squarely on the plush center seat cushion with back against the curved backrest
Glide across smooth indoor flooring using feet to push, allowing 360-degree swivel wheels to roll smoothly

timeline.scene: A person is crouching uncomfortably on a hard garage concrete floor, bent double trying to clean a car tire, rubbing their lower back in pain.
The person sits down softly and squarely on the low-profile rolling backrest chair (dark grey cushion, off-white frame), resting their back comfortably.
The person glides smoothly along the side of the car tire using their feet to push, effortlessly wiping the wheels on the rolling stool.
The person glides easily across the flat floor, showing the silent 360-degree swivel caster wheels rotating smoothly.
The person rolls over to a low tool cabinet to retrieve detailing sprays, keeping an upright, comfortable sitting posture.
A light visual text overlay displays: 'A simple upgrade for everyday floor-level work.' against a clean shot of the stool.
